hints: Which courses can be taken first? What happens to the rules once one of them is taken?
A course is available when nothing still has to come before it - when its count of unmet prerequisites is zero. Taking it reduces that count for everything it unlocks.
Keep the available courses in a structure, take one, and push whatever its removal makes available. Repeat until nothing is left.
Because the answer must be the smallest by course number, that structure is a min-heap rather than a queue: always take the lowest-numbered available course.
